name: close-reason-recorded
description: The host writes the reason of each close of a connection to the application log: a frame over the limit, a body that is not JSON, a JSON value that is not a request, an undeclared method, and the end of the connection by its peer after the page was told that the last watcher ended.
reason: The page of the case is a script that the host producers play; a running application has a page of its own that answers differently.
